outcome.answer: Yes. Several papers say a single general-purpose or foundation model can handle multiple atmospheric tasks without task-specific retraining, including probabilistic forecasting, downscaling, reconstruction, and conservation constraints [1]. Another paper says scaling a general-purpose model is sufficient for state-of-the-art medium-range prediction across probabilistic frameworks [4], and a separate review notes that foundation models are intended for broad adaptation, though no single geospatial foundation model is universally best [6].
